description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of Intestate, in the village of Andiambalama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511204 and 04 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers for multiple properties across different districts. The content focuses on land title registration procedures for deceased persons' properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
